Known relevant authors in FRB research: Bart Spitler, Laura Spitler, Kenzie Nimmo, Kiyoshi Masui, Joeri van Leeuwen, Vikas Ravi, Shunsaku Horiuchi, et al.

- The title and arXiv ID of both papers
